generic_residual_capability_boundary.evidence: Available invocation tools support role-local repository writes and public research, but expose no generic external authoritative sink revoke/reseal/transfer operation.
generic_residual_capability_boundary.minimum_generic_effect: Authoritative sink must either produce absorbing retirement/reseal proof for every superseded member of a coupling group before new authority is granted, or atomically transfer/fence old->new authority for the group.
